item.title: 100 Years of Poul Anderson by Open Road Media
item.content:encoded:
There are few writers of science fiction and fantasy as prolific and beloved as Poul Anderson, whose novels were just as inspired by ancient myth as they were by humanity’s hopes and dreams for the future. A multiple-time winner of both the Hugo and Nebula Awards, a SFWA Grand Master, and an inductee to the Science Fiction and Fantasy Hall of Fame, Anderson’s lasting influence on fiction writing can still be felt even decades after his passing. To celebrate what would be Anderson’s 100th Birthday, we’ve teamed up with Open Road Media to offer a huge collection of his best novels, from his Viking fantasy instant classic The Broken Sword to his saga of humanity’s past, present, and future, The Boat of a Million Years. Grab this collection of 42 ebooks and stack your library with Poul Anderson’s best. Pay what you choose and support the Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers Association!
